caption: The drawing depicts a single clear glass bottle with a rounded stopper placed on top. The bottle is vertically oriented in the center of the image, and the background is a plain, light beige color with no other objects or decorations present. The glass bottle has a narrow neck that flares slightly at the rim, and the stopper is shaped like a sphere. The body of the bottle features distinct decorative patterns, including vertical ridges on the lower half, crisscrossed diamond shapes and horizontal bands in the middle section, and elongated teardrop or leaf-like motifs rising upward toward the neck. The drawing is rendered in shades of grey and black, using fine lines and shading techniques to convey the reflective and transparent properties of the glass. The artist’s signature is visible in the bottom left corner of the paper.
title: Cruet Bottle
